title: BIG Molecular Screening Feasibility Study
brief_summary: This pilot study examines the feasibility and turnaround time of performing and obtaining data from a few key molecular assays. These assays will be performed using different laboratories and technologies from core biopsies taken from patients diagnosed with invasive recurrent or metastatic breast cancer. All results will be uploaded, stored and assessed using the IT Molecular Screening Prototype Platform (MSPP). The MSPP will also be evaluated for ease of use to screen patients for participation in future molecularly defined clinical trials in breast cancer.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Written informed consent for all study procedures according to local regulatory requirements prior to enrollment into the study.
2. Age ≥ 18 years.
3. Histologically proven metastatic or locally recurrent invasive breast cancer.
4. Tumor tissue (FFPE and frozen) from recurrent or metastatic lesions available for research purposes.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status \>2.
2. The biopsy procedure is estimated to be too risky for the patient.
3. Any bevacizumab treatment administered less than 3 weeks before new biopsy procedure.
4. No appropriate wash-out period for patients on anticoagulation therapy.
